atomic_metadata_cases.name: metadata_filter
atomic_metadata_cases.rationale: Catalog Metadata uses FlateDecode, forbidden by PDF/A-1.

atomic_metadata_cases.name: missing_identification
atomic_metadata_cases.rationale: No property uses the PDF/A identification namespace.

atomic_metadata_cases.name: duplicate_identification
atomic_metadata_cases.rationale: Conflicting duplicate identification declarations probe reference model behavior.

atomic_metadata_cases.name: title_mismatch
atomic_metadata_cases.rationale: Info Title differs from dc:title x-default.

atomic_metadata_cases.name: subject_mismatch
atomic_metadata_cases.rationale: Info Subject differs from dc:description x-default.

atomic_metadata_cases.name: creation_date_equivalent_offset
atomic_metadata_cases.rationale: Different offsets denote the same instants.

atomic_metadata_cases.name: author_multiple
atomic_metadata_cases.rationale: dc:creator contains more than one entry.

atomic_metadata_cases.name: baseline_b
atomic_metadata_cases.rationale: Canonical B declaration and RDF forms pass targeted rules.

atomic_metadata_cases.name: accepted_a
atomic_metadata_cases.rationale: The 1b profile accepts a level A declaration.

atomic_output_intent_cases.name: baseline
atomic_output_intent_cases.rationale: A 20-byte header prefix contains every field used by the pinned test-1 predicate; one indirect profile satisfies identity.

atomic_output_intent_cases.name: no_output_intents
atomic_output_intent_cases.rationale: Without OutputIntents, neither pinned rule has a model object to evaluate.

atomic_output_intent_cases.name: wrong_type_array
atomic_output_intent_cases.rationale: A non-array OutputIntents value is ignored by the pinned output-intent model.

atomic_output_intent_cases.name: empty_array
atomic_output_intent_cases.rationale: An empty array creates no pinned OutputIntents model object.

atomic_output_intent_cases.name: non_dictionary_entries
atomic_output_intent_cases.rationale: The pinned model ignores non-dictionary array entries.

atomic_output_intent_cases.name: direct_intent_dictionary
atomic_output_intent_cases.rationale: Direct output-intent dictionaries are retained by the pinned model.

atomic_output_intent_cases.name: missing_s
atomic_output_intent_cases.rationale: Pinned test 1 does not reference S despite its prose description.

atomic_output_intent_cases.name: wrong_s
atomic_output_intent_cases.rationale: Pinned test 1 evaluates linked profile fields without gating on S.

atomic_output_intent_cases.name: missing_dest_output_profile
atomic_output_intent_cases.rationale: A missing destination profile creates no ICCOutputProfile and is ignored by identity.

atomic_output_intent_cases.name: direct_wrong_type_profile
atomic_output_intent_cases.rationale: A direct non-stream profile value creates no test-1 object and has no indirect identity.

atomic_output_intent_cases.name: indirect_wrong_type_profile
atomic_output_intent_cases.rationale: One indirect non-stream target creates no test-1 object and trivially satisfies identity.

atomic_output_intent_cases.name: truncated_profile
atomic_output_intent_cases.rationale: Nineteen bytes cannot expose the complete class and colour-space fields; veraPDF also reports its adjacent ICCBased N/colour-space rule.

atomic_output_intent_cases.name: class_prtr
atomic_output_intent_cases.rationale: Printer is one of the two accepted device classes.

atomic_output_intent_cases.name: class_scnr
atomic_output_intent_cases.rationale: Input-device class is not accepted.

atomic_output_intent_cases.name: color_cmyk
atomic_output_intent_cases.rationale: CMYK is an accepted profile colour space.

atomic_output_intent_cases.name: color_gray
atomic_output_intent_cases.rationale: GRAY is an accepted profile colour space.

atomic_output_intent_cases.name: color_lab
atomic_output_intent_cases.rationale: Lab is outside the three accepted profile colour spaces.

atomic_output_intent_cases.name: version_2_15
atomic_output_intent_cases.rationale: The pinned parser reads the high nibble as minor version 15 and 2.15 is below 3.0.

atomic_output_intent_cases.name: version_3
atomic_output_intent_cases.rationale: Version 3.0 is not below 3.0.

atomic_output_intent_cases.name: two_shared_indirect_profiles
atomic_output_intent_cases.rationale: Both intents reference the same indirect profile object.

atomic_output_intent_cases.name: two_shared_invalid_profiles
atomic_output_intent_cases.rationale: Two intents share one class-invalid profile, isolating a test-1 failure while identity passes.

atomic_output_intent_cases.name: two_identical_indirect_profiles
atomic_output_intent_cases.rationale: Byte-identical profiles under different object IDs fail the identity predicate.

atomic_output_intent_cases.name: two_different_indirect_profiles
atomic_output_intent_cases.rationale: Different valid profiles under different object IDs fail the identity predicate.

atomic_output_intent_cases.name: one_profile_one_missing
atomic_output_intent_cases.rationale: Entries without DestOutputProfile are ignored by the identity comparison.

atomic_output_intent_cases.name: two_same_wrong_type_indirect_profiles
atomic_output_intent_cases.rationale: The identity predicate compares indirect IDs even when the shared target is not a stream.

atomic_output_intent_cases.name: two_different_wrong_type_indirect_profiles
atomic_output_intent_cases.rationale: Different indirect IDs fail identity even when neither target is a stream.

atomic_font_cases.name: unembedded_visible
atomic_font_cases.rationale: A visible TrueType font has no embedded font program.

atomic_font_cases.name: mixed_rendering_modes
atomic_font_cases.rationale: veraPDF 1.28.2 retains rendering mode 3 from the font's first text-show use.

atomic_font_cases.name: mixed_visible_first
atomic_font_cases.rationale: veraPDF 1.28.2 retains visible mode 0 from the font's first text-show use.

atomic_font_cases.name: direct_font
atomic_font_cases.rationale: A directly embedded Font resource dictionary still instantiates the rule.

atomic_font_cases.name: form_unembedded
atomic_font_cases.rationale: Visible text in a Form XObject uses an unembedded font.

atomic_font_cases.name: inherited_resources
atomic_font_cases.rationale: The page inherits its unembedded font resource from the Pages node.

atomic_font_cases.name: type0_unembedded_descendant
atomic_font_cases.rationale: Type0 is exempt directly, but its used unembedded CIDFont descendant is not.

atomic_font_cases.name: type0_embedded_descendant
atomic_font_cases.rationale: The CIDFont descendant is embedded; the synthetic font's unrelated glyph failure is recorded explicitly.

atomic_font_cases.name: type3_visible
atomic_font_cases.rationale: Type3 is exempt from the embedding rule; incomplete synthetic glyph data triggers unrelated rules.

atomic_font_cases.name: direct_descriptor
atomic_font_cases.rationale: A direct descriptor resolving to an indirect valid font program is accepted.

atomic_font_cases.name: direct_font_file
atomic_font_cases.rationale: A direct descriptor and direct valid font-file stream are accepted.

atomic_font_cases.name: malformed_font_program
atomic_font_cases.rationale: veraPDF does not expose containsFontFile for a stream whose bytes are not a recognized font program.

atomic_font_cases.name: graphics_state_visible
atomic_font_cases.rationale: A visible text-show inside q/Q records visible rendering mode.

atomic_font_cases.name: cyclic_form
atomic_font_cases.rationale: The used font is checked once while cyclic Form recursion is bounded.
